title: No. 16 Highlighter Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Vegan
What it is: A precision, fanned-out highlighter brush with dense, stippling bristles made of soft vegan fibers designed for targeted, customizable application.

Brush Formulation: Liquid

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Crafted with a lightweight aluminum handle for effortless control, this brush offers a comfortable, balanced grip for precise application. Designed to complement the Unreal Liquid Highlighter (sold separately), it also works beautifully with powder and cream cheek formulas.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Lightly dip brush into cream or liquid highlighter.
-Start at the top of the cheekbones, gently sweeping in soft, upward motions using the brush horizontally.
-To highlight high points of the nose and brow bone, turn the brush vertically and swipe for targeted application.
-Repeat until desired results are achieved.

Cleaning Instructions:
-Gently clean bristles with mild soap and warm water.
-Lay flat to dry.
